about: Charles A. Beckham, Jr. is an attorney who represents clients in the Houston, Texas area. Charles Beckham, Jr. is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2003 - 2026. Charles Beckham, Jr. chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended St. Mary's University School of Law and graduated in 1979. Charles Beckham, Jr. passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1979.
He represents clients with Bankruptcy: Business issues in Texas.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Charles Beckham, Jr. has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
